name: chart
title: Chart
description: Bar, line and area charts drawn as SVG from data in the colour-blind-safe chart.cat roles, with axes, legend, keyboard-readable tooltip, a hidden data table, decimation for long series, and an inline sparkline.
usage: Use Chart for a small set of series over categories or time: statements per hour (bar), connections by state (stacked area), latency over the last N statements (line). Pass data (one object per category), x (the category field) and series ({ key, label, color? }); aria-label says what the chart shows. stacked stacks bars or areas; valueFormat and xFormat format numbers and categories. Long series are decimated to the plot width. ChartSparkline is a tiny trend line for a table cell or a Stat. For one number use Stat; for exact values use Table. Charts are built here on SVG (Base UI has none; the project adds no chart library).

props.name: series
props.description: The series; colour defaults to the series' position in chart.cat.

props.name: legend
props.description: Show the legend; default for more than one series.

props.name: onActiveIndexChange
props.description: Called when the marked category changes.

slots.name: guide
slots.description: The vertical guide at the marked category; data-slot="chart-guide".

parts.name: ChartLegend
parts.description: The legend list: each series' swatch (colour and dash) and name.

parts.name: ChartTooltip
parts.description: The box with the category and each series' value.

parts.name: ChartSparkline
parts.description: A tiny inline line, role="img" with a summary label; values, color, area.

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: Keyboard focus on the plot: a ring of ring.width in color.ring.

accessibility: The plot is one tab stop (role="group", aria-roledescription="chart", named by aria-label); Left and Right move between categories, Home and End to the ends, Escape clears; a polite live region reads the category and each series' value.

A visually hidden table (caption, column and row headers) holds the data and describes the plot (aria-describedby); above 1,000 rows a summary of each series' range replaces it. The SVG itself is aria-hidden.
chart.cat colours are colour-blind safe, and series differ by more than colour: lines and areas have their own dash pattern and marker shape (shown in the legend), bars keep their order.
ChartSparkline is role="img" with a label that states first, last, lowest and highest values.
